column1: # Task 7: simulate() now requires a temperature source whenever bioen is enabled.
# 15.0 reproduces the pre-Task-7 _bioen_step fallback exactly -- with phit disabled and
# no oxygen source configured, temperature reaches the energy budget through only one
# path (the Arrhenius maintenance term via temp_c_arr), which the old fallback filled
# with the literal value 15.0. Provable numeric no-op, not a forcing-value choice
# placeholder pending real Baltic bottom/surface temperature forcing.
